summary: Hike-in Nez Perce National Forest camp 9 miles ENE of Elk City, dated 1938 and abandoned in 1942; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Camp abandoned in 1942 per three sources; none describes a structure or what, if anything, remains

visit.trail_note: Listed as Hike-In on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page

events.note: Established as a camp, not a tower

corrections.why: Sources describe a camp dated 1938 and abandoned in 1942, not a tower
The sources say the camp was abandoned in 1942; none says what was removed or what remains

notes_for_editor: Dates agree across three sources (Idaho page, firelookout.com, USFS 2010 list). Location is not confirmed: the record point (45.86454, -115.26467) is not in any source read, and the FFLA Idaho list places a Simmons Ridge camp at 45.86134, -115.12461 (us-id-simmons-ridge-3), about 11 km farther east. These are probably one camp; merge or verify the record, and set county to Idaho County if confirmed. The USFS 2010 list marks lookouts still standing by highlighting, which plain-text extraction does not show, so the current state is unverified; a human should check the PDF's highlighting for this row. Research used 1 search call (plus the shared lookout pages).
